title: DAG Visual Builder
description: Full ReactFlow drag-and-drop workflow editor. Palette sidebar with node types: job, approval, delay, condition, notify, fan-out. Drag nodes onto canvas, connect with edges. Each node has config panel. Generates workflow JSON. Bidirectional: load existing workflow → render as graph, edit graph → update definition.
definitionOfDone: Palette sidebar with draggable node types: job, approval, delay, condition, notify, fan-out
Connect nodes with edges to define dependencies
Click node opens config panel (right sidebar or modal)
Each node type has appropriate config fields
Generates valid workflow JSON definition from graph
Load existing workflow JSON and render as graph (bidirectional)

implementationPlan.description: Create dashboard/src/components/workflow/WorkflowCanvas.tsx: ReactFlow canvas component for workflow editing. Uses ReactFlow with custom node types registered. Drag-and-drop from palette to canvas via onDrop handler. Nodes connected with edges (smoothstep edge type). Canvas controls: zoom, fit view, minimap. Background grid pattern. onNodesChange and onEdgesChange update local state. Export function: graphToDefinition() converts ReactFlow nodes/edges to workflow JSON definition. Import function: definitionToGraph() converts workflow JSON to ReactFlow nodes/edges (bidirectional).
implementationPlan.note: Created ReactFlow canvas with drag-and-drop, bidirectional definitionToGraph/graphToDefinition converters, smoothstep edges, minimap, controls, background grid, snap-to-grid.

implementationPlan.description: Create dashboard/src/components/workflow/BuilderSidebar.tsx: Left sidebar with draggable node palette. Node types: job (Briefcase icon), approval (ShieldCheck icon), delay (Clock icon), condition (GitBranch icon), notify (Bell icon), fan-out (Split icon). Each item is draggable (onDragStart sets dataTransfer with node type). Section header 'Node Types'. Below palette: workflow metadata (name input, description textarea).
implementationPlan.note: Draggable node palette (6 types with icons), workflow name/description inputs.

implementationPlan.description: Create dashboard/src/components/workflow/nodes/ directory with custom ReactFlow node components: JobNode.tsx, ApprovalNode.tsx, DelayNode.tsx, ConditionNode.tsx, NotifyNode.tsx, FanOutNode.tsx, and index.ts barrel export. Each node: styled card with icon, title, status indicators, connection handles (top=target, bottom=source). Click opens config panel.
implementationPlan.note: 6 custom node types with BaseNode shared layout. Each has icon, label, accent color, config preview, and top/bottom handles.

implementationPlan.description: Create dashboard/src/components/workflow/NodeConfigPanel.tsx: Right sidebar that opens when a node is clicked. Form fields vary by node type: Job node (topic, capabilities, timeout, retry config), Approval node (approver roles, timeout), Delay node (duration), Condition node (expression), Notify node (channel, message template), Fan-out node (parallelism). Uses React Hook Form + Zod for validation. Save updates the node data in ReactFlow state.
implementationPlan.note: Config panel with RHF+Zod per-type schemas. Job: topic, capabilities, timeout, retryMax. Approval: approverRoles, timeout. Delay: duration. Condition: expression. Notify: channel, messageTemplate. Fan-out: parallelism. Form resets on node change, save updates node data.

implementationPlan.description: Create dashboard/src/components/workflow/WorkflowBuilder.tsx: Orchestrator component combining BuilderSidebar + WorkflowCanvas + NodeConfigPanel. Manages selected node state. Save button calls useCreateWorkflow() or useUpdateWorkflow(). Loads existing workflow via useWorkflow(id) and converts to graph on mount.
implementationPlan.note: Orchestrator combining BuilderSidebar + WorkflowCanvas + NodeConfigPanel. Loads existing workflow, manages selected node state, save via useCreateWorkflow/useUpdateWorkflow.
